# Summit Solutions

> Done-for-you lead management for home service businesses (roofing, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, landscaping, remodeling, and similar trades). Summit builds and fully manages a system that texts back missed calls in 30 seconds, follows up automatically, lets leads self-book, and nurtures estimates until they close — so the leads a business already pays for turn into jobs.

## About

- Company: Summit Solutions
- What it does: Builds and runs lead-capture and follow-up automation for home service businesses. Clients never log into the backend; Summit owns and manages it.
- Core features: missed-call text-back (business + after hours), two-way texting in one inbox, self-booking calendar with confirmations and reminders, multi-touch follow-up, custom sales pipeline, auto-sent branded estimates with nurture sequences, won/lost tracking, review and referral automation, monthly reporting, and database reactivation.
- Case study: Husky Roofing — in their first 6 weeks live, the system texted back 37 missed calls, booked 32 inspections, and produced $43,000 in won jobs (two deals: $26,000 and $17,000), all originating from missed calls.
- Location: Los Angeles, CA (serves the US).
- Contact: sid@summitsolutionscrm.com, (424) 387-7320.

## Packages

- Starter — Stop missing calls: missed-call text-back, two-way texting, self-booking calendar, confirmations and reminders, office notifications.
- Growth — The full pipeline: everything in Starter plus multi-touch follow-up, custom pipeline, auto-sent estimates with nurture, won/lost tracking, review and referral automation.
- Partner — Fully managed: everything in Growth plus monthly reporting, quarterly database reactivation, win/loss and lead-source analysis, deliverability monitoring, and ongoing optimization.
- Pricing model: each package is a flat monthly fee plus a one-time build fee, scoped on a call. Monthly service has a 30-day money-back guarantee.
